👇 快在留言区告诉我们：

你心目中那一首，到现场绝对要撕声力竭大合唱的神曲是什么？

Every night, a different setlist. 🎤✨ Alan Tam’s 10-show run at the Hong Kong Coliseum is in full swing, thrilling fans with fresh surprises each night.
This November 28th and 29th, the music, energy and memories make their way to Malaysia as part of his final world tour!!
